items.statement: The bounded calculation preserves Q(CH3)4 connectivity and treats radical-anion (-1, doublet) and dianion (-2, singlet) states with one CH3OH in PCM acetonitrile at 298.15 K and 1 atm.
items.expected: Both identities and all state/solvent/temperature/pressure settings are explicit and consistent.

items.statement: The report identifies the submitted public conformer/pose subset and its candidate selection, deduplication and stopping boundary.
items.expected: It does not silently present a subset as the complete ConfLEX ensemble.

items.statement: At least one optimized stationary pair candidate per redox state is supported by convergence/frequency evidence and contacted-atom mapping, or a truthful bounded failure is recorded.
items.expected: Both state-specific candidates retain validation context.

items.statement: ΔH1, ΔH2 and ΔH_HB are explicitly derived from complex, isolated quinone-ion and methanol enthalpy components under one convention.
items.expected: Arithmetic is reproducible from submitted components.

items.statement: The bounded result tests whether dianion complexation is more favorable than radical-anion complexation and whether ΔH_HB is negative.
items.expected: The sign and relative-strength conclusion are supported by the submitted values; exact SI numbers are an informative comparison, not a hard gate for the reduced scope.

items.statement: The report states the public-conformer subset, model dependence and absence of full ConfLEX ensemble statistics.
items.expected: No bulk/device conclusion is inferred from the subset.
